annotations.title: Revoke a key this connection created

description:
[DESTRUCTIVE] DESTRUCTIVE: revokes ONE child key this connection created (`id` from child_key_list). The agent holding it loses access at once. Repeating is safe. Any other key (this connection itself, its parent, a sibling) answers 404 and the attempt is audited.
(Wraps DELETE /api/v2/keys/{id}.)
name: child_key_revoke
title: Revoke a key this connection created
